for each centre how much did the shuttle sprint time change on average between the two tests
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH matched_children AS (
    SELECT
        b."Child ID",
        b."Location",
        b."Shuttle Run sec" AS baseline_shuttle,
        e."Shuttle Run sec" AS endline_shuttle
    FROM
        sportathon_baseline b
    LEFT JOIN
        sportathon_endline e
        ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(b."Child ID")), lower(trim(e."Child ID"))) >= 0.9
        AND b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
    QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b."Child ID" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(b."Child ID")), lower(trim(e."Child ID"))) DESC) = 1
),
valid_changes AS (
    SELECT
        "Location",
        AVG(NULLIF(endline_shuttle - baseline_shuttle, 0)) AS avg_time_change_seconds
    FROM
        matched_children
    WHERE
        baseline_shuttle IS NOT NULL
        AND endline_shuttle IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        "Location"
)
SELECT
    "Location",
    ROUND(avg_time_change_seconds, 2) AS average_shuttle_time_change_seconds
FROM
    valid_changes
ORDER BY
    "Location";
```
